findings.claim: ASRS auto-repair composes a service restart shell command from diagnosis evidence, classifies safe patterns by substring containment, and executes with shell=True. A non-executing synthetic classifier replay confirms that safe-prefix-plus-extra-shell-syntax remains LOW. Current frozen Project-Frankenstein contains the same design, so this is a historical failure oracle rather than independent Drive novelty.
findings.implication: Typed effect/resource validation must replace shell-string authority; service identifiers need strict validation and argument-vector execution.

findings.claim: invariants/core_kernel.py states the core is always non-empty/min_core_size, while build_core returns [] for no nodes and on errors; min_core_size cannot be guaranteed when fewer candidates exist.
findings.implication: Invariants must be executable construction/check contracts with explicit unavailable/bootstrap states, not prose assertions.

findings.claim: Triple Reality's shadow is initialized from a primary DB backup and receives the same logical operations; declared different RNG seeds are not materially used by the shown synchronization path. Divergence rollback currently copies primary to shadow rather than restoring both from a stable checkpoint. Agreement therefore cannot be credited as independent replication.
findings.implication: Record ancestry/intervention identity for every replicate and distinguish clone replay, deterministic differential run and genuinely independent replication.

findings.claim: Neural-Immune Drive code records an Aug-1 restart-loop failure caused by collapsing systemd transitional states into inactive; fix skips activating/deactivating/reloading. Lifecycle also removes deprecated rooms/nerd-physics/aura from startup waves to avoid resurrecting disabled/zombie services.
findings.implication: Recovery tests must represent transitional lifecycle states and decommissioned-component tombstones explicitly; global restart must never resurrect retired modules.

findings.claim: ContextGate hard-codes eight channels as ALWAYS_PASS; learned/rule gating cannot suppress those channels despite broad 15-channel framing.
findings.implication: Measure gate effect only on gateable channels and expose bypass channels in causal readouts.

branch_feedback.harness: Add ASRS command-composition counterexample, core-empty invariant violation, non-independent Triple-Reality clone agreement, transitional-systemd restart loop, zombie-resurrection and gate-bypass fixtures.
branch_feedback.claycode: Effect/resource/capability types must replace shell-string risk classification; parser validity never grants authority.
branch_feedback.frank: Lifecycle state requires typed transitional/decommissioned states; Drive post-head recovery fixes supersede older binary active/inactive assumptions.
branch_feedback.goodman: Clone/shadow agreement shares ancestry and cannot satisfy independent-evidence promotion.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Stable-checkpoint/rollback claims require actual snapshot identity and bidirectional restore semantics; copying primary to shadow is resync, not rollback-both.
